test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d0d9529cdfff1a2c0048af10ba1036540d5a4007084a1ae0323a20742e8ecc9.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: Symbol 'Triangle' has shifting one place in clockwise direction in next images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c292a4e5690b88302a994d28bd36fee4aa04bcdff7b1c3ebb44b264f8e2ffab4.png] 

Step II: Symbol 'Arrow' has shifting a place in clockwise direction in next images, and changed with symbol '=' and then letter 'B' respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a0bacdc7aecd2c96bc9b99b5bd8e05ff72a37516098900c90db43ff72b59900.png] 

Step III: Symbol 'Circle' has shifting a place in clockwise direction in next images, and changed with symbol 'Square' and then letter 'S' respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e0492123e89f78d3b6eab61f8e07ea04c1855faf1890bad8bdd6c29998718fc.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60fc93f143ff24625ba0cf07670770d11c75b62a39a345900c1490c72349b526.png] 

So, 'Option 3' will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
